clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope—Requirements for materials, construcation, workmabship, finish, perfornance  and  testing  for gel  - coated glass fibre reinnforced  polyester  resin  bath tubs.

clauses.title: Materials
clauses.text: 2. Materials

clauses.title: Glass Fibre – The
clauses.text: 2.1 Glass Fibre - The fibre glass used shall be low alkali glass (for example, E-glass) compatible with polyester  resin.

clauses.title: The glass content of
clauses.text: 2.1.1 The glass content of the laminate shall be minimum  30 percent by weight.

clauses.title: Polyester resin
clauses.text: 2.2 Polyester resin—Unsaturated polyester  resin used in  the manufacture of bath tubs should  be resistant to hot water and weathering. A ratio of not less than 1: 2 of glass fibre to polyester is recommended.

clauses.title: Fillers and Colouring Materials
clauses.text: 2.3 Fillers and Colouring Materials—When filler and colouring materials are used, their quality and proportion should be compatible to the polyester and the materials should not have any harmful effect on the quality and performance of bath tubs.

clauses.title: Gel
clauses.text: 2.4 Gel-coat— The bath tub should possess a uniform gel-coat on the working  surface.The gel-coat used shall be based on isophthalic grade of polyester, or  epoxy resin or any equally suitable chemical resistant grade of resin .

clauses.title: Workmanship and Finish
clauses.text: 3. Workmanship and Finish

clauses.title: The bath
clauses.text: 3.1 The bath  tubs shall be free from cracks, crazing, pinholes, blisters or chipped areas or moulding defects that may affect their appearance and service-ability. There shall be no readily visible wrinkles in any area when viewed with lighting. The gel-coat  shall be free from  voids and no voids between  the gel-coat  and the back-up resin shall be closer than 0.5 mm to the inner face.

clauses.title: Requirements
clauses.text: 5. Requirements

clauses.title: Each bath tub shall
clauses.text: 5.1 Each bath tub shall be one piece unit with an opening for waste out let. An overflow shall normally be provided. Apron (side panel) may be provided integrally or seperately.

clauses.title: Thickness of laminbase including
clauses.text: 5.2 Thickness of laminbase including gel coal shall not be less than 2 mm for apron, 3 mm for inner wall and bottom  and 4 mm tor bottom bend.

clauses.title: Performance Requirements
clauses.text: 6. Performance Requirements

clauses.title: Impact Resistance
clauses.text: 6.1 Impact Resistance :  Shall not show cracks in the gel-coat when subjected to impact test.

clauses.title: Hardness
clauses.text: 6.2 Hardness —Shall show a minimum  reading of 40 points on a bareolimpressor or any other equally suitable apparatus.

clauses.title: Cracking or Crazing
clauses.text: 6.3 Cracking or Crazing—Shall not show on visual inspection any signs of cracking or crazing after the oven test.

clauses.title: Water Absorption
clauses.text: 6.4 Water Absorption — Shall not absorb water in excess of 0.5 percent in 24 hours.

clauses.title: Gel
clauses.text: 6.5 Gel-Coat — Shall not be less than 0.25 mm thickness nor more than 1.00 mm thickness.

clauses.title: Resistance to Boiling Water
clauses.text: 6.6 Resistance to Boiling Water— There shall be no crazing , bubbless,dis-colouration when test pieces are subjected to boiling water.

clauses.title: Resistasnce to Hydrochloric Acid
clauses.text: 6.7 Resistasnce to Hydrochloric Acid— There shall be no crazing, discolouration, exposure of glass fiber, etc, .when subjected to the test for hydrochloric acid.

clauses.title: Tensile Strength Test for Laminates
clauses.text: 6.8 Tensile Strength Test for Laminates — The tensile strength of the laminate at any point shall not be less than 6.5 MPa.

clauses.title: Washability
clauses.text: 6.9 Washability — Shall withstansd 40 000 cycles in the scrub test and only slight brush marks at the completion   of the  test shall be permited. Note: For Methods of tests, refer to 8 of the standard For detailed information, refer to IS 6411  : 1985 Specification for  Gel-coated glass fibre reinforced polyester resin bath tub (first revision).
